# resume

> Hieu Doan's resume and resume editor. `/` renders the resume;
> `/editor` is a client-side resume editor that produces YAML/JSON matching the
> `resume-core` schema (camelCase fields: personal, contact, websites,
> summary, experience, education, projects, skills, certifications,
> languages, interests, references).

- Site: https://hieudoanm.github.io/resume/
- Source: https://github.com/hieudoanm/resume
